title: Formal scope: what the Lean catalogue establishes and defers
html:
Remark. Formal scope: what the Lean catalogue establishes and defers

Formal scope

What is established:

  • The named function delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_witness : ℕ → ℚ in Lean returning the witness-recorded coefficient at each order.
  • Sorry-free reflexivity-level theorems delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_witness_0 = 0 and delta_tau_M_surrogate_taylor_witness_1 = -5/6 matching the formally-proved Lean theorems on the exact derivative-at-1.

What is deferred:

  • Sorry-free n-th derivative theorems for orders 2..7. Each requires a quotient-rule chain n+1 levels deep. These remain stated as Lean theorems with sorry and -- Ref: citations to the witness JSON.
  • A closed-form recursion for the c_n. The underlying rational function forms a degree-11/degree-7 quotient, so a finite-order linear recursion on c_n exists, but extracting it remains open.
